retrieval_skill.name: dated_mechanism_retrieval
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve evidence of operational disruptions or regime changes that directly alter the latent process underlying the forecasted outcome.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When a forecast horizon may overlap a real-world intervention, outage, supply constraint, policy shift, or other mechanism-level change.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for the target process together with disruption and regime-change terms, constrain results to the forecast window, and extract claims that state both the affected interval and the causal effect on the measured outcome.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a claim only when a reliable source explicitly supports the mechanism, its temporal overlap with the forecast window, and its effect on the target variable; preserve exact-quote and provenance requirements, and do not infer unsupported dates, magnitudes, or outcomes.
